svg.aria-label: Three scatter panels. Left: 420 samples of the source distribution forming four separated clusters, with open circles marking the component means. Middle: the target distribution after a rotation relation, which preserves the cluster structure while rotating it by sixty degrees. Right: isotropic Gaussian noise as a control, unimodal and without cluster structure.
svg.text: four-component Gaussian mixture | 420 samples | circles are component means
after the relation | cluster structure preserved, rotated 60 deg
